title: Hooks Engine
description: Core hooks engine. Orchestrates rule matching, feature execution, and dedup state.

processEvent.description: Process a hook event through the pipeline: match rules → check fired state → execute features.

loadEventSchema.description: Load the schema for a named hook event (e.g. 'PreToolUse', 'PostToolUse').

paused.description: True if all rule processing is paused (pass-through mode).

x-docs.intent: Engine module acts as the glue between rules, features, and state. Not directly exposed via bus; called by hook.mjs internally.
